scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bisect/vm run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/merkle run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/web run build
scripts.contracts:vectors: pnpm --filter @bisect/vm run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/merkle run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/vm exec tsx ../../scripts/generate-phase4-vectors.mts && biome format --write contracts/test/vectors/verifier-v1.json
scripts.check:phase4: pnpm check:phase3 && pnpm contracts:build && pnpm contracts:test
scripts.merkle:vectors: pnpm --filter @bisect/vm run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/merkle run build && pnpm --filter @bisect/vm exec tsx ../../scripts/generate-merkle-vectors.mts && biome format --write packages/merkle/fixtures/merkle-v1-vectors.json
scripts.db:health: node scripts/run-docker.mjs compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U bisect -d bisect
scripts.check:phase3: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
